draft.emotion: assertive and clear, like a sign at a crossroads commanding attention
notes: In Mexico, 'parar' is widely used to mean 'to stop' (a car, an action, a machine). It is synonymous with 'detener'. If you mean 'to stand up', use 'ponerse de pie' or 'pararse' (which is very common in Mexico).
Be careful not to confuse 'parar' with 'dejar de', which specifically means to quit doing something (e.g., 'dejó de fumar' - he quit smoking).
